candidates.title: keynote-parser: arbitrary file write (zip-slip) via unsanitised ZIP member names in .key files
candidates.body_excerpt: ## Summary `keynote-parser` writes ZIP member names verbatim to disk when unpacking a `.key` file, with no `basename()` stripping, no `realpath()` confinement check, and no rejection of absolute paths. An attacker-supplied `.key` archive can write arbitrary files anywhere the process has write access — well outside the designated output directory — on both Windows and POSIX systems. Tested version: **1.14.5.0** --- ## Vulnerable code **`keynote_parser/file_utils.py` — `dir_file_sink.accept()`:** ```python ensure_directory_exists(target_dir, filename) # makedirs on traversed path — outside target target_path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename) # '..' hops / absolute path drops the base open(target_path, "wb").write(data) # arbitrary write at attacker-controlled path ``` `zip_file_reader()` (lines 92–105) re-decodes member names cp437→UTF-8 (a no-op for ASCII) and skips only names ending in `/`. A base64-encoded pickle stream in a cookie triggers no rule, even at PL4. We found this while evaluating CRS on the public API Traffic Research Dataset Framework (ATRDF). candidates.body_excerpt: ### 结论 `vulnclaw solve --stream` / `vulnclaw run --stream` 在任务**已经成功**（flag 已取证、evidence 已落盘）之后抛 `TypeError` 退出，收尾的 `emit_complete_event()` 从未执行，进程退出码 1。 **严重性：低。** 不影响取证、报告生成与数据落盘——崩溃发生在这些动作之后； 仅影响 CLI `--stream` 模式的消费方（退出码 1、收不到 `complete` 事件）。 普通用户通过 REPL / TUI 使用时不经过该代码路径。修复成本约 2 行。 ### 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | OS | Windows 11 (10.0.26200) | | Python | 3.14.5 | | VulnClaw | 0.4.1（`pip install vulnclaw`，PyPI wheel，源码零改动） | | LLM | deepseek-v4-pro（OpenAI 兼容接口） | | 相关分支 | `main`（3811 行）与 `dev`（3813 行），2026-10-26 均未修复 | ### 触发条件 只在 `verified_claims` 计数 > 0 时触发，即"真的验证成功过至少一条结论"才崩；计数为 0 时 `(0 or [])` 会退化成空列表，一切正常。所以它在失败运行里隐形、**在成功运行上必现**，CI 也容易漏掉。 ### 与模型供应商无关 - `solve`（非 `--stream`）的 `on_event` 崩溃发生在任何模型调用之前：把供应商换成不可达地址 + 假 key，**1.2 秒内**仍然复现同一个 `UnboundLocalError`，说明它根本不依赖模型。 - `--stream` 的 `TypeError` 只取决于"本次运行是否产出 ≥1 条 verified claim"：用同一个假供应商（0 条 claim）跑同一目标，**不抛** TypeError，正常输出 `{"type":"complete","summary":"⊘ not reached — steps=0 evidence=0","result":{"findings":[]}}`，退出码 0；换回可用

candidates.title: Security: quadratic-time denial of service (ReDoS) in section-header parsing
candidates.body_excerpt: Hi — reporting a denial-of-service (uncontrolled resource consumption, CWE-1333 / CWE-400) in configobj 5.0.9 (latest). The section-marker regular expression in `configobj/__init__.py` backtracks quadratically on crafted section-header input, so a small configuration (tens of KB) can consume many seconds of CPU (O(n²)). Any application that parses untrusted or attacker-influenced configuration with configobj can be driven into CPU exhaustion. This is distinct from CVE-2023-26112 (which was in `validate()`). This repo doesn't appear to have GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting enabled and I couldn't find a SECURITY.md contact. Could you enable private reporting (Settings → Security) or share a security contact so I can send the full proof-of-concept privately? Happy to help with a fix. — mohammad adnan (cystack.ps redteam) / @mohammedix88
